source.title: AlphaEvolve-Style Verifier/Generator Separation: Held-Out Question Bank & Independent Verification for Ship Resistance

disposition_reason: No blocking finding on the registration duty: the source hash re-derives byte-exactly, the tallies reproduce, both unresolved assets are corroborated, and zero-claim registration is legal for task 01. 12/20 checks reproduce, 5 fail (F-01/F-02 package hygiene; F-03/F-04/F-05 subject-report arithmetic) and 3 are declared not_run. The approval covers registration mechanics only; it does not endorse report 444 §6, which is escalated for rework.

re-derivation of every structural tally and every quote locator the upstream package asserts
the envelope printed in the upstream result document against schemas/kf_result.v1
independent re-derivation of the numbers report 444 prints in §3/§6 and in the governance block, against the formulas the report itself names

the figure payload (not served: the record carries name+caption only)
whether report 444's 15/15 tally is a correct harness result — untestable without the question bank or the verifier code
Cf against experimental tank data: §6's own baselines are analytic formulas, so this review is formula-to-print, not ship-to-model
scope.claims_assessment: wp-444-01 declares zero knowledge claims, so what is assessed is the truth of its statements about the source, plus (as carried findings) the arithmetic of the report it registered. Nothing here is marked verified.

limitations: reviewer and producer are the same model family on the same platform: independence is identity-level and method-level, not model-level
the producer's machine-readable manifest was not reachable, so C12 is not_run rather than passed
record-level facts (title, figures, scenario_key) are online-only; the committed snapshot carries the markdown and nothing else, and every check that needs more is flagged offline_reproducible=false
no second independent reviewer and no strong-model resample were drawn (platform jobs, not available here)

findings.title: three of the five markdown-pinned quotes in the upstream evidence table are reflowed, not byte-verbatim
findings.why_it_matters: The upstream self-check row asserts `所有引文可在 markdown 原文逐字定位` with a check mark. Three of them cannot: table rows were normalised into one line (`A 5/5 / B 3/3`) while the source holds GFM rows. A downstream gate that substring-checks quotes fails them, and a reader cannot tell a reflow from a paraphrase.

findings.title: the envelope printed in the upstream result document does not validate against schemas/kf_result.v1
findings.why_it_matters: The envelope is the machine-checkable contract of the workflow. As printed it carries provenance keys the schema closes against and an output key without the .json suffix; if the emitted file equals the printed block the package fails its own contract. Unsettleable here because the manifest itself is absent (C12).

findings.remediation: Print the envelope verbatim from the emitted file (or label it an excerpt) and keep producer output free of self-verification keys.

findings.title: §6 ITTC-1957 baseline is 4.16% away from the formula the report names
findings.why_it_matters: §6 declares `<3% ✓ YES` with a 0.0% deviation, but its 基准 value is not the ITTC-1957 line at the Re it states: 0.075/(log10 1e8-2)^2 = 0.002083 versus the printed 0.002170 (+4.16%). The printed value belongs to Re ≈ 7.57e+07, not 1e8. A reader anchoring model-ship conversion on report 444 inherits a 4.2% Cf bias.
findings.remediation: Recompute report 444 §6 from the named formulas and re-issue the error table, or state which Re / line variant was used.
findings.affects: report 444 §6 accuracy claim (not the registration duty of wp-444-01)

findings.title: §6 Prandtl-Schlichting baseline is 5.47% away from the formula the report names
findings.why_it_matters: Same failure mode on the turbulent line: 0.455/(log10 1e8)^2.58 = 0.002128 versus the printed 0.002012 (-5.47%); the customary -1700/Re term moves it to 0.002111 (-4.70%), so no variant of the named formula rescues the printed value. The row is marked `<3% ✓ YES`.

findings.title: the two §6 friction baselines are ordered the wrong way round at Re=1e8
findings.why_it_matters: Above the crossover at Re ≈ 9.15e+06 the ITTC-1957 line lies below Prandtl-Schlichting; at 1e8 the formulas give 0.002083 < 0.002128. The report prints ITTC (0.002170) > P-S (0.002012). The inversion is internal evidence that both baselines were written from memory, and it needs no external reference data to detect.
findings.remediation: Covered by the F-03/F-04 rework; add an ordering invariant to the verifier question bank.

findings.title: §6 Holtrop-Mennen 1+k is under-determined and sits outside the standard formula's envelope for Cb=0.6
findings.why_it_matters: The row states Cb=0.6 only while the report's own parameter table lists Cb, L, B, T; 1+k depends on (L, B, T, Cp, nabla), so the value cannot be re-derived: WITHHELD, not passed. Over 360 plausible Cb=0.6 hull tuples the Holtrop-Mennen form factor spans 1.1295-1.2490 (median 1.1958); the printed 1.0547 lies below that envelope, and the caveat `使用了简化版本` names no simplification that would explain the offset.

findings.remediation: Declare the simplification and its coefficients, or move the row out of the accuracy table into an unverified list.

findings.title: the one fully reproduced baseline sits at the edge of its own validity range
findings.why_it_matters: Blasius reproduces exactly (+0.00%), but the row evaluates it at Re_L=1e6 — the upper end of the range the report's own parameter table declares ([1e5, 1e6]) and the usual upper bound of laminar similarity. The only row that survives re-derivation is the least transferable one.

findings.remediation: Evaluate at Re_L = 5e5 and add a turbulent flat-plate case instead.

findings.title: the universal 0.0% deviation is disclosed self-consistency, not validation
findings.why_it_matters: §3 prints 0.0 max deviation on all 15 rows, §5 discloses why (candidate and question bank share one formula), and upstream registered the missing figure payload as unresolved. Read together report 444 does not overstate: the tally is a plumbing test of the verifier harness and must not be cited as an accuracy result.

findings.remediation: No correctness change; cite §3 as a harness self-test only.
